name: 표현)"마침" / "혹시" - 자연스러운 영어 구사를 위한 필수 영어 표현

keywords.en: happen
keywords.ko: [마침]
happen to +동사원형

keywords.en: I happen to have some cash on me right now.
keywords.ko: 마침 나에게 현금이 좀 있어
*have sth on me 나한테 있다. 소지하고 있다는 뉘앙스

keywords.en: I happen to have a really good idea.
keywords.ko: 마침 나한테 진짜 좋은 생각이 있거든

keywords.en: I happended to have some left over pizza from yesterday in my refrigerator
keywords.ko: 마침 냉장고에 어제 먹다 남은 피자가 있어

keywords.en: → there was/were +<happen to> ⇒ there happened to be
keywords.ko: →~가 있다/없다 를 there is/are 로 표현이 가능

keywords.en: There happened to be left over pizza from yesterday in my refrigerator.
keywords.ko: 내가 아는 사람 중에 마침 곧 호주에 가는 사람이 있거든

keywords.en: I happen to know someone who is planning to go to Australia soon.
It just so happens(happened) that + S + V
bold_words: It just so happens(happened) that + S + V

keywords.en: It just so happens that I have some cash (on me)
It just so happens that I have a really goo idea
It just so happens that I have some left-over pizza from yesterday in my refrigertaor
It just so happens that I know someone who is planning to go to Australia soon.
